rv.q: Actors are seldom given space to convey their characters' inner lives; when they are, they shine.
This production brought to life one of Shakespeare’s best-known comedies in an innovative and moving way, handled with great direction and care from the cast and production team at the RSC.
The RSC's apparent reverse-Globe scheduling policy of rarer Shakespeare plays in the summer and the most famous ones in winter continues with Twelfth Night as the holiday show.

cn.t: The RSC's festive production earns praise for Samuel West's superb Malvolio and its musically uplifting approach, with critics applauding memorable performances and the show's tinsel-inflected take on Shakespeare's comedy.
